name: WOL Forwarder
description: Wake-on-LAN (WOL) magic packets with a matching secureOn are broadcasted on your LAN.

ports_description.5000/tcp: HTTP API status endpoint (only when http_api_enabled is true)

options_description: listen_port: UDP port to receive magic packets with secureOn (usually above 50000, add-on uses host network). wol_port: broadcast destination (only when secureOn is correct). allowed_hosts: optional list of hostnames; when set, only packets from the resolved IPs are allowed. dns_ttl: DNS cache TTL in seconds. http_api_enabled: enable HTTP API for monitoring. api_port: HTTP API port.
author: erkr
